description: Extended canonical mass table via per-atom route: A<2 -> direct H_3 Hoefsmit (laurent_q_rust, falling back to laurent_q when pyhecke_native is absent); A>=2 -> operator-valued Wenzl branching combiner; + mpmath y_λ. Layer 1 canonical pipeline per docs/audits/2026-05-18-all-atoms-isotopes-plan.md. Coverage is determined by --atoms (see parameters.atoms_requested); the actual rows reflect what completed within the per-atom timeout. Each row carries the per-atom IsotopeRecord with explicit knot-operator catalogue (intra-nucleon, inter-nucleon interfaces, closure topology). For p and n, the prediction column is the Borromean-tower nucleon mass (conditional on conj:borromean-baryon-mass-formula, sub-ppm vs CODATA); for D and up the prediction column is the mass-table-ppb binding energy (Kashaev law / α-cluster / volume-match).

parameters.nucleon_prediction_route: canonical_mass.nucleon_mass_mev (muon-anchored Hecke energy, flavour-split substrate identity). NOT the Path C route (m_p + Q_beta + m_e) used by per-observable-100x-status; the two differ by ~555x on m_n. See bean qou-khue.
